plan.fixed_parameters: Width EMA31, anti-chase2 widths, activation2%, reverse confirmation1, EMA(hl2), EMA(high-low), no ATR initial stop. Center34/55/89 x crossing.4/.8 x stop1/2 =12 entries. Same set for all4 assets.
plan.methods_rule: All5 methods keep opposite exit and reversal entry rules. Price caps apply only after the same profit activation and use favourable peak/trough price, not entry price. At peak+100%, g50 retains+50%, cap10 retains+80%, cap5 retains+90%. Ratchet on closed candle; new line is live on next observed candle; gaps use actual open.
plan.periods_rule: Intraday pool5m/15m/30m/1h uses3-year trailing selection, then6-month test, six rounds from2023-10-01 to2026-09-10 (last round partial). All5 adds daily on same dates for everyone, only the last2 rounds; PAXG650 daily warmup prevents a full3-year daily training sample earlier. Do not rank totals across unequal pool durations.
plan.training_scores: For each exact timeframe/entry/method, compute six consecutive half-year marked-equity log returns in preceding3 calendar years. Candidate paths start flat in2020-10 (daily2022-10), continue causally, and use calendar equity at cutoffs. Training windows can inherit positions initiated earlier, all past. Training trades are exits known by cutoff.
plan.robust_selection: Require own3-year return>0 and>=30 closed trades. Neighborhood contains self plus all entries differing in exactly one of the3 axes, same timeframe and protection. Score is median over that neighborhood of each member median six-half-year log return. Require score>0. Rank score, then own median half-year log return, own3-year log return, ID. If none qualifies stay cash. Scores cannot use subsequent half-year results.
plan.comparisons: Joint robust selector chooses timeframe,entry,protection. Five method-specific robust selectors choose timeframe/entry with each exit method fixed. A return-only past3-year selector is a diagnostic control. Five paired exit comparisons use the entry/timeframe selected under originalg50. Five fixed originalETH1h entry comparisons never reselect. Shared replays deduplicated.
plan.atr_confirmation_comparison: Six risk modes x five protection methods on both g50-selected entry/timeframe and fixed original ETH1h. Fixed comparison remains active if adaptive selector stays cash. Modes: original percent/ATR14x2/ATR14x3, each with1/2 reversal close confirmation. ATR replaces percent stop; existing stops active during confirmation. Freeze before any training; no promotion of test winner.
plan.replay: At each scheduled half-year boundary close existing holding at prior candle close and start next segment flat, regardless of whether selection changes; boundary is known in advance. New strategy first sees first test candle at its close, next observed open execution. Same reset for all controls, g50 methods and paired methods. OOS segment10000 normalised, concatenate actual compounded equity and trades; no using future winner.
plan.freeze_sequence: Cache causal candidate paths once for computation. Worker returns only prior-window scores, not full returns. Selector accepts only strictly-before-cutoff performance, freezes all fold choices and hashes BEFORE the selected next-segment replays. Full candidate paths are not used to choose hindsight winners or to rewrite choices.
plan.interpretation: Historical prices and many related strategies already examined. This is retrospective causal walk-forward evidence, not a genuinely untouched holdout; correlated crypto assets are not four independent experiments. Daily only2 tests, insufficient for a durable optimum. No grid expansion or threshold change after results.
plan.retention: Original source/engine/results unchanged; separate opt-in engine. All1200 candidate trade+signal traces and daily/boundary equity compressed onD; configs, source hashes, chronological selection ledgers, each selected replay, verification and report retained.
plan.stop_rule: Run this single frozen grid and rule on all4 assets, report failures/stay-cash periods without rescuing with a post-hoc winner. No automatic future schedule or live trading.
